an10.73:1.1: dasayime bhikkhave dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.3: bhogā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.4: vaṇṇo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.5: ārogyaṃ iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpaṃ dullabhaṃ lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.6: sīlāni iṭṭhāni kantāni manāpāni dullabhāni lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.8: mittā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.9: bāhusaccaṃ iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpaṃ dullabhaṃ lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.10: paññā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.11: dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ sattā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ
an10.73:1.12: ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ.
an10.73:2.1: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave dasannaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ dasa dhammā paripanthā
an10.73:2.2: āsassaṃ anuṭṭhānaṃ bhogānaṃ paripantho asajjhāyakiriyā bāhusaccassa paripantho assussusā aparipucchā paññāya paripantho ananuyogo apaccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ paripantho micchāpaṭipatti sattānaṃ paripantho
an10.73:2.3: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave dasannaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ ime dasa dhammā paripanthā.
an10.73:3.1: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave dasannaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ dasa dhammā āhārā anāsassaṃ
an10.73:3.2: uṭṭhānaṃ bhogānaṃ āhāro maṇḍanā vibhūsanā vaṇṇassa āhāro sappāyakiriyā ārogyassa āhāro kalyāṇamittatā sīlānaṃ āhāro indriyasaṃvaro brahmacariyassa āhāro avisaṃvādanā mittānaṃ āhāro sajjhāyakiriyā bāhusaccassa āhāro sussusā paripucchā paññāya āhāro anuyogo paccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ āhāro sammāpaṭipatti sattānaṃ āhāro
an10.73:3.3: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave dasannaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ ime dasa dhammā āhārāti.
